verdict.rationale: Docs describe a globally installable CLI (`npm i -g foreloop`) that works across projects, agents, and cron jobs, supports `--json` output with a stable additive schema, and integrates with `foreloop init` to set up agent workflows — clear evidence of an official, agent-friendly CLI. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI's real-world reliability and no mention of command-level reference docs or version history.
